applicant: Authenticated representative in server-created applicant context, own application only
authenticated: Current authenticated principal; minimal safety concern only
assigned_reviewer: Exact review_assignments person and registered role_slot; current membership; no author or same-person alias
registered_transition_actor: Exact code, source state, assignment and actor rule in study_transition_registry.json; authority aliases resolve only to current verified people named in the applicable source ownership/gate record
named_successor: Principal designated in the exact ownership assignment; cannot nominate self
delegated_member: Membership carries discover/read capability on explicit resource scope; membership role alone is insufficient
record_editor: Registered draft editor for domain and scope; immutable states forbidden
trusted_scorer: Workload identity admitted for exact sealed benchmark version and scoring manifest; no interactive person
precedence: Payload-kind rules constrain domain roles; a PM cannot create an institution application through this role, and an applicant cannot create a programme.
